goal: Make all nine Phase 57L intake queues executable against future cited records without inventing evidence, coercing source labels, or automating a publication decision.
publication_rule: Publish only adapter, fixture, and human-review control records; preserve all nine outcome holds and treat every fixture and rehearsal as non-evidence.
authority_rule: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN workflow controls, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.

records.title: Amtrak maps 12 required fields through non-coercive schema adapters
records.finding: 12 field adapters preserve exact labels, definitions, units, authority, period, and privacy boundaries without populating a source value.
records.denominator: 2 contracts, 12 adapters, and zero observed or populated adapter values.
evidence_limits: An adapter vocabulary is not evidence that a source field exists.
Unrecognized labels are never coerced.
No value transformation or cross-record carry is allowed.
records.next_action: Apply the adapter only to one cited candidate packet and return any ambiguous label for clarification.
records.authority_boundary: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN workflow controls, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.

records.title: Amtrak declares 24 exact accepted input labels
records.finding: Each Amtrak field admits one canonical label and one readable label while rejecting unrecognized or ambiguous labels without inference.
records.denominator: 24 adapter-vocabulary labels across 12 required fields.
evidence_limits: Accepted labels are workflow vocabulary, not observed source evidence.
Case normalization does not permit semantic aliasing.
A label match cannot supply a value.
records.next_action: Record the exact source label and citation when an actual candidate packet enters review.
records.authority_boundary: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN workflow controls, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.

records.title: Amtrak builds empty and deliberately incomplete non-evidence packet fixtures
records.finding: 2 empty canonical packets and 2 incomplete synthetic packets expose missing-field, privacy, authority, period, and disqualifier handling.
records.denominator: 4 fixtures and zero candidate evidence records.
evidence_limits: Fixture placeholders are not source values.
Fixtures cannot enter the evidence ledger.
Incomplete packets cannot fire a trigger.
records.next_action: Use the fixtures only to test intake behavior before reviewing a cited official record.
records.authority_boundary: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN workflow controls, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.

records.title: Amtrak defines 12 human-review rows across six outcomes
records.finding: Every Amtrak contract rehearses accept, reject, clarification, privacy-hold, authority-hold, and period-hold paths without evaluating a candidate record.
records.denominator: 2 decision tables, 12 rehearsal rows, and zero actual accept decisions.
evidence_limits: Decision rows are rehearsals, not evidence decisions.
Accept routes only to separate publication review.
No row closes a hold automatically.
records.next_action: Require a named reviewer to record one bounded decision and reason for each actual packet.
records.authority_boundary: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN workflow controls, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.

records.title: Amtrak accepts zero evidence packets and fires zero reopening triggers
records.finding: Adapters, fixtures, and decision rehearsals make the review workflow executable but do not supply, evaluate, or accept an evidence packet.
records.denominator: 2 contracts, 12 fields, 4 fixtures, and zero accepted evidence packets.
evidence_limits: Workflow infrastructure is not operating evidence.
No accept-path rehearsal establishes eligibility.
Every inherited outcome hold remains In Review.
records.next_action: Keep the hold until one complete cited packet clears all checks and a separate human publication review approves it.
records.authority_boundary: Agency assertions, independent oversight, FTFN workflow controls, acceptance, implementation, capability, closure, and operating outcomes remain separate evidence states.
